purpose: Resolved journalist abduction benchmark set for validating forensic route behavior before any private shadow analysis of an active case

sources.title: Correspondent abducted in Baghdad
sources.notes: CPJ records that Rory Carroll was seized on October 19, 2005 as he left a house in Sadr City after an interview.

sources.title: War-zone crisis: What to do when the unthinkable happens
sources.notes: The article quotes Carroll's own account: 'It was 2.15pm on Wednesday' when the kidnapping began.

sources.title: Italian reporter kidnapped in Iraq
sources.notes: The Guardian reports that four gunmen snatched Giuliana Sgrena from her car at about 2pm outside Baghdad University.

sources.title: Italian Journalist Kidnapped in Baghdad
sources.notes: Fox reports that Sgrena was seized shortly before 2 p.m. near the Baghdad University compound at the Jadriyah bridge.

sources.title: CPJ welcomes release of Jill Carroll
sources.notes: CPJ states that Carroll was seized on January 7, 2006 while leaving the office of Adnan al-Dulaimi in the Adil neighborhood of western Baghdad.

sources.title: A statement from the Monitor
sources.notes: The Christian Science Monitor says Carroll was abducted in western Baghdad on Saturday morning local time in the Adil neighborhood.

sources.title: 60 Second Spot: It's time for Jill Carroll to come safely home
sources.notes: The Christian Science Monitor case material describes Carroll's 10 a.m. interview appointment and says she was dropped off roughly 20 minutes earlier before being seized shortly after leaving the office area.

sources.title: British journalist abducted in Basra, later released
sources.notes: CPJ records that James Brandon was taken from Al-Diyafa Hotel in Basra at about 11 p.m. local time on August 12, 2004 and released the following day.

sources.title: Al Mezan condemns the kidnapping of BBC journalist
sources.notes: Al Mezan field information says that at approximately 14:45 on March 12, 2007, four gunmen in a white Subaru blocked Alan Johnston on Al Wehda Street and forced him out of his car.

sources.title: BBC correspondent Alan Johnston Freed
sources.notes: CPJ records that Johnston was released alive in early July 2007 after nearly four months in captivity.

sources.title: Annual Report 2007
sources.notes: PCHR documents that at approximately 19:40 on August 14, 2006, armed men kidnapped Fox journalists Steve Centanni and Olaf Wiig in Gaza City.

sources.title: CPJ calls for release of Fox News journalists kidnapped in Gaza
sources.notes: CPJ says gunmen ambushed the Fox crew on Omar al-Mukhtar Street in central Gaza City on August 14, 2006 and abducted Steve Centanni and Olaf Wiig.
